catalog.name: Windows PC
catalog.description: Your Windows PC, shell, files, screen.
catalog.hint: The name is how you both refer to it ("check the logs on my-laptop"). Adding hands you a one-liner to run there.

steps: Add the computer here: a one-time command appears straight away, and `Connect` on its card brings it back later.
Run it in `PowerShell` on that computer: it installs a small agent.
Nothing is opened on your network: the connection is outbound, so no port forwarding and no VPN.
Revoke any time from this card; `intentic-host uninstall` removes the agent.

steps: Add the computer here: a one-time command appears straight away, and `Connect` on its card brings it back later.

Revoke any time from this card; `intentic-host uninstall` removes the agent.
